how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: Your hands, about 10 minutes, so the free tool tests can start (both programs are installed, thank you). (1) Open Houdini 22 from the Start menu once; when it asks about a licence, pick 'Install my free Houdini Apprentice license', then close it. (2) Open Cascadeur from the Start menu once and sign in with your new account, then close it. (3) MetaTailor: make a free account on its site and install its free app (first link). FaceBuilder needs nothing from you: its 15-day trial starts when the session first runs it. Then tap Done.
sections.recommendation: Done: the Houdini and Cascadeur tests you asked for can't start without the licence and sign-in.
